pharma.title: Centre Proposes Amendments to Drugs Rules for Batch Release Compliance
pharma.summary: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has proposed amendments to the Drugs Rules to mandate that qualified personnel authorise all drug batch releases. This move aims to ensure strict quality control, safety standards, and accountability across pharmaceutical manufacturing in India.
pharma.source_title: Centre proposes amendments to drugs rules to ensure qualified personnel authorise drug batch release - DD News

national.title: MHA Unveils 'PRAHAAR', India's First National Counter-Terror Policy
national.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs has formally released 'PRAHAAR', representing India's first unified national counter-terrorism policy. The framework strengthens inter-agency coordination, intelligence sharing, and defensive capabilities against modern security threats.
national.source_title: MHA unveils ‘PRAHAAR’, India’s first national counter-terror policy - DD News

national.title: Union Cabinet Approves Changes to FDI Rules for Bordering Nations
national.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved revisions to Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) regulations governing investments from nations sharing land borders with India. The updated guidelines aim to balance national security requirements with streamlined investment scrutiny.
national.source_title: Cabinet approves changes in FDI rules for investments from countries sharing land border with India - DD News

national.title: Maharashtra Launches 'MahaGPT' AI Tool for Government Resolutions
